thesis: Jason Citron describes his transition from a video game player to a developer, noting that while working professionally in the industry was thrilling, the hit-driven economics of the entertainment sector were challenging. He explains that his frustration with this environment led him to join a tech incubator where he attempted to build games on social networks, though he faced difficulty creating products people wanted and experienced several failed startup ideas before the App Store announcement changed the landscape.
